description: Aperture Systems NetWatch 410 is a network monitoring appliance for isolated factory networks. It collects link health, latency, and availability metrics without requiring an internet connection. Features include four copper ports, a read-only dashboard, and exportable event summaries. Category: network monitoring. Manufacturer: Aperture Systems. Specs: Storage=128 GB; Ports=4; Mount=1U rack. Tags: network, observability, appliance.
